d:
• 35,000 vs ₹3500 hotel rooms! But this time in Mussoorie, it’s not just about the hotel experiences, but about evaluating our luxury versus budget days in completely different ways!
The common denominator? The Maruti Suzuki Grand Vitara! From driving through misty mountain roads to living two sides of the same hill - this trip was all about contrasts that somehow felt complete together.
On both days, I checked out the hotels, tried a Garhwali thali, and visited my favourite cafés!
